instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text: Answer the following questions briefly (any seven) :

sub_questions.text: Compute the collector current if base current is $60 \mu A$ and current gain is 70.
Define ripple as referred to in a rectifier circuit.
A Zener diode has how many p-n junctions?
Write the formula for total power dissipated by a transistor in terms of voltage and current associated to transistor circuit.
What is the value of $V_{BE}$ for a C-E configuration, when a silicon transistor is forward biased?
In a base resistor method, if the value of $\beta$ changes by 50, then by what factor collector current will change?
In voltage divider bias, $V_{CC} = 25 V$. $R_1 = 10 k\Omega$, $R_2 = 2.2 k\Omega$, $R_C = 3.6 k\Omega$ and $R_E = 1 k\Omega$. What is the emitter voltage?
When drain voltage equals the pinch-off-voltage, then what will happen to drain current if drain voltage increases?
At which point in JFET biasing, the JFET is not longer able to control the current?
Why is an SCR made of silicon and not germanium?
Explain Hall effect phenomenon and list out its applications. Quantitatively discuss the use of Hall effect to determine mobility.
Define static and dynamic resistances of diode. What are their uses?

In the circuit given below, the Zener voltage ($V_Z$) = 6 V, knee current ($I_Z$) = 6 mA and maximum power dissipated in Zener diode ($P_{max}$) = 0.4 W. Compute maximum and minimum values of $R_L$ such that $V_o = 11 V$ for the satisfactory operation of this circuit : [Diagram: Zener regulator with source 15V, series resistor $R_s=80\Omega$, Zener diode $V_Z=6V$ in series with a 5V source, and output voltage $V_o=11V$ across load resistor $R_L$.]
Draw the circuit diagram of full-wave bridge rectifier and give its input and output waveforms. Also derive the expression for the DC current.
Explain the working of full-wave bridge rectifier with the help of its circuit diagram, input and output waveforms. List the advantages and disadvantages of this rectifier.
Define stabilization factors S, S' and S''. Derive the expression of S for fixed bias transistor circuit.
A transistor amplifier connected in CE mode has $\beta = 80$ and $I_B = 30 \mu A$. Compute the values of $I_C, I_E$ and $\alpha$.
Explain the working of RC low-pass filter and draw its frequency response. Compute the cut-off frequency if RC circuit consisting of a resistor of $8 k\Omega$ in series with a capacitor of 60 nF.
Compute the stability factor S for emitter feedback bias circuit. How the stability of Q-point is better in emitter feedback bias compare to fixed bias circuit?
Why is an FET known as a unipolar device? How do you compare this device with BJT?

Data sheet of an EMOSFET specifies the following parameters : $I_{D(on)} = 60 mA$ at $V_{GS} = 7 V$ and $V_T$, the threshold voltage for EMOSFET is equal to 3 V. Determine the drain current at $V_{GS} = 4 V$.
Explain thermal runaway. Show graphically that thermal runaway cannot take place if the quiescent point is located at $V_{CE} < (1/2) V_{CC}$.

An inverting op-amp has $R_f = 120 k\Omega$ and $R_1 = 4 k\Omega$. Find the voltage gain of the amplifier. Also find the amplifier input resistance, input current and the output voltage, if the Input voltage is 0.2 V. Assume op-amp to be ideal.
Discuss a current-series feedback amplifier and compute the expression for transconductance using low-frequency approximate h-model of amplifier with an unbypassed emitter resistance.
Draw the V-I characteristic of silicon-controlled rectifier (SCR) and explain different parameters of the curve. Explain any two SCR triggering or turn-on methods.
Explain the characteristics of an ideal op-amp. Mention two applications of op-amp. Draw the integrator circuit using op-amp.
